stories.headline: A mouse once thought extinct now has 3 new wild colonies
stories.summary: Pacific pocket mice, North America's smallest mammal, were thought extinct until 1993. San Diego Zoo has released 500+ since 2006, and a third new colony on a Marine Corps base is already breeding.
stories.why: A species we nearly lost is spreading out again, one thumb-sized mouse at a time.

stories.headline: Common heart pills may help save sight from glaucoma
stories.summary: In a study of 420,000 people, glaucoma patients taking statins were 36% less likely to need incisional surgery within 5 years, and 55% less likely to need keyhole surgery, than those who didn't.
stories.why: A cheap, widely used pill could help slow a leading cause of blindness.

stories.headline: A complete Roman window grille turned up, nails and all
stories.summary: At Augusta Raurica near Basel, diggers found an iron grille with five bars and two of its original nails still in place. Roman windows almost never survive whole, since wood rots and iron rusts.
stories.why: It shows how Romans secured their windows, a detail history almost always loses.

stories.headline: Hubble spotted a smiley face made of galaxies
stories.summary: In a new Hubble image, two orange galaxies form the eyes and a white galaxy forms the nose and smile. The round face comes from gravitational lensing, where a cluster's mass bends light into an arc.
stories.why: Einstein's bent spacetime, drawn as a cosmic grin.

fun_fact: A Pacific pocket mouse is about as long as a human thumb.
